nodes.label: YJAutoPostOnX
nodes.summary: Electron 30 desktop app that generates professional Arabic tweets with AI, collects them in a shared queue, and auto-publishes them to X.com across multiple accounts from a single RTL Arabic interface.

nodes.label: AI Studio (استوديو الذكاء)
nodes.summary: First of three independent pipeline stages: generates tweets with AI, filters them through a strict quality gate, blocks semantic duplication, and injects the referral link at generation time.

nodes.label: Shared Queue (الطابور المشترك)
nodes.summary: Second pipeline stage: receives accepted posts from the studio or CSV import and supports review, delete and export. A consumable queue that publishing always starts from the first item.

nodes.label: Publishing Engine (محرك النشر)
nodes.summary: Third pipeline stage: pulls posts from the queue and publishes them to X literally as-is, 100% independent of referral settings — no gate, no link editing, no post rejection.

nodes.label: Referral Link Injection
nodes.summary: The user's referral link is embedded automatically into every generated tweet at generation time inside the studio.

nodes.label: Publishing/Referral Independence
nodes.summary: Architectural rule that the publishing engine is fully independent of referral logic; referral settings never affect publishing behavior.

nodes.label: Strict Quality Gate (بوابة الجودة)
nodes.summary: Automatically rejects texts that are too short/long, have broken emoji, leaked English model-thinking text, or are incomplete drafts and ideas.

nodes.label: Semantic Duplicate Prevention
nodes.summary: Rejects literal matches, paraphrases and same-idea-different-words by comparing each new tweet against everything previously published plus the queue, preview and all generated text, with no time window.

nodes.label: semanticIndex.js (IDF Inverted Index)
nodes.summary: Semantic index using IDF weighting and an inverted index that keeps constant-time comparison even with 100k+ tweets.

nodes.label: Full Arabic Normalization
nodes.summary: Normalizes diacritics (تشكيل), hamza forms and roots so that semantic comparison works reliably on Arabic text.

nodes.label: Unlimited Parallel Sessions
nodes.summary: No cap on parallel generation sessions (50, 500, more); the count can be raised or lowered during generation with staggered launch to keep the UI smooth.

nodes.label: 170–270 Character Tweet Constraint
nodes.summary: Generated Arabic tweets must be 170 to 270 characters long, with emoji and hashtags included.

nodes.label: Optional Custom Prompt
nodes.summary: An optional user-supplied prompt plus full preview before adding to the queue, with a stop action that keeps already accepted items.

nodes.label: Consumable Queue Semantics
nodes.summary: Each post is published exactly once: on successful publish and link capture it is permanently deleted from queue.json; unpublished posts stay in place for the next account or next run.

nodes.label: Mandatory Numbered Profiles
nodes.summary: Profiles are always numbered — default is 1 and each new one takes the next number (2- محمد، 3- علي); a run starts at the selected profile and only continues forward, never wrapping backwards.

nodes.label: Smart Rate Limit Handling
nodes.summary: Detects X's posting limit and reacts by handing off the post, cooling down the profile and advancing the account pointer.

nodes.label: daily_post_limit Detection
nodes.summary: Detects the daily post limit URL (daily_post_limit) and performs immediate textual detection from the very first failed attempt.

nodes.label: Post Handoff to Next Account
nodes.summary: A post that hit the rate limit is immediately handed to the next account instead of being lost, while the original account's pointer advances so it is not repeated.

nodes.label: Per-Profile Cooldown
nodes.summary: A persisted cooldown per profile, extracted from X's own message when available, with a live countdown and manual cancel.

nodes.label: Circuit Breaker (قاطع دائرة)
nodes.summary: Precautionarily stops an account after 3 consecutive unexplained failures.

nodes.label: True Instant Stop (≤200ms)
nodes.summary: The stop button interrupts all waits and attempts within 200ms or less.

nodes.label: Anti-Detection Behavior
nodes.summary: Random delays, natural mouse movement, human-like scrolling, and 3 attempts per post to avoid automation detection.

nodes.label: queue.json
nodes.summary: The lock-protected shared JSON queue file stored in ~/.config/x-poster-shared; successfully published posts are deleted from it permanently.

nodes.label: published.json
nodes.summary: Archive of published posts in ~/.config/x-poster-shared that feeds the duplicate-prevention index.

nodes.label: Virtual Lists
nodes.summary: Virtualized list rendering that handles thousands of posts smoothly in the queue and preview.

nodes.label: CSV Import / Export
nodes.summary: Import posts into the queue from CSV and export the queue to CSV, alongside bulk delete.

nodes.label: Spintax Support
nodes.summary: Supports Spintax syntax {خيار1|خيار2} inside post text, plus a per-post character counter.

nodes.label: Live Run Reports
nodes.summary: Live run reporting with a percentage, a fractional counter, and CSV logs written per session.

nodes.label: Automated Security Audit (npm run audit)
nodes.summary: Automatic security audit that checks for hardcoded URLs and validates the integrity of state files.

nodes.label: Local-Only API Key Storage
nodes.summary: API keys are stored locally only and are never leaked into logs.

nodes.label: AI Provider Auto-Detection
nodes.summary: Automatically detects the provider type (OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini) from the Base URL, with ready-made providers in a list and one-click fetching of available models.

nodes.label: dev/main.js (Electron main + IPC)
nodes.summary: Electron main process hosting IPC and the generation orchestrator for the app.

nodes.label: dev/preload.js (window.api bridge)
nodes.summary: Preload script exposing the window.api bridge between the renderer UI and the main process.

nodes.label: contentEngine.js
nodes.summary: Builds the prompt and enforces the quality gate for generated content.

nodes.label: sessionManager.js
nodes.summary: Manages the parallel generation sessions.

nodes.label: queueManager.js
nodes.summary: Implements the shared consumable queue: add, delete, consume.

nodes.label: xPoster.js
nodes.summary: Publishes posts to X via Playwright, independent of referral logic.

nodes.label: dev/security/
nodes.summary: Holds the audit, URL scanning, and settings migration logic.

nodes.label: dev/ui/ (4 screens)
nodes.summary: The Arabic RTL user interface consisting of 4 screens.

nodes.label: dev/config/ (AI provider list)
nodes.summary: Configuration directory containing the list of AI providers offered in the app.

nodes.label: test/ (framework-free tests)
nodes.summary: 20+ test files with no test framework; npm test runs the full 11-file chain.

nodes.label: ~/.config/x-poster-bot-profile
nodes.summary: Local per-profile directory storing settings and cooldown state.

nodes.label: ~/.config/x-poster-shared
nodes.summary: Local shared directory holding queue.json and published.json.

nodes.label: Arabic RTL Interface
nodes.summary: The whole product is driven from one Arabic right-to-left interface.
